title: approval_log
description: Memory block written by Agent 3.3 (Approval Workflow). The review-queue routing ledger for a content cycle: one entry per upstream content item, recording how it is routed through the single human reviewer's queue (route, priority, reviewer role, review-by deadline, status) plus alerts and a footing summary. Reads: content_calendar (3.2, primary) with content_plan (3.1) as fallback, optional client_profile constraints. Read by Layer 6 reporting and the Firestore review-queue UI. Human gate: queue manager (autonomous — gate_status is always auto_approved).

item_id.description: Id of the upstream content item being routed (from content_calendar or content_plan).

campaign_id.description: Campaign this item belongs to, if known.

channel.description: Distribution channel of the item (instagram, meta_ads, email, whatsapp, blog, landing_page, ...).

format.description: Content format (reel, carousel, ad_creative, landing_page, email_single, ...).

topic.description: Client-facing topic/angle echoed verbatim from the upstream item (ES-MX). Not rewritten by this agent.

scheduled_for.description: Scheduled publish timestamp/date of the item, if the calendar provided one.

review_required.description: Whether a human must clear this item before it ships.

route.description: The lane this item is routed into.

reviewer_role.description: Who clears it: operator (single reviewer, default), partner (approval-chain commercial sign-off), or none (auto_publish).

review_by.description: Deadline by which the item must be cleared to publish on schedule. Null when no scheduled date is known.

status.description: Initial lifecycle state set by this agent: queued (human_review/escalate), auto_approved (auto_publish), blocked (hold). Operator advances queued -> approved/returned later.

overdue.description: True when review_by is at or before the run timestamp and the item is still queued/blocked.

flags.description: Constraint/risk tags that influenced routing (e.g. pricing_claims, data_privacy, dependency_hold, autonomous_organic).

rationale.description: One short sentence (EN) explaining which rule routed this item and why.

matched_rule.description: Label of the routing rule that matched (e.g. 'RULE 4 — autonomous organic').

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this approval_log (routing run) was generated. Also the reference 'now' for overdue detection.

gate_status.description: Gate posture of this agent's OWN output. Always 'auto_approved' — Agent 3.3 is an autonomous queue manager. Per-item gating lives in entries[].route / entries[].status, not here.

cycle_month.description: Marketing cycle this ledger covers, YYYY-MM. Null if not derivable from the upstream block.

source_block.description: Which upstream block the entries were routed from. 'none' when nothing was available to route.

entries.description: One routing decision per upstream content item. May be empty only when nothing was available to route (source_block = 'none').

alerts.description: Overdue / queue-overload / missing-input / dependency-hold alerts surfaced to the operator.

notes.description: EN — assumptions, fallback used (calendar vs plan), overload/empty-cycle reasons.
